mechanism: Decompose each univariate series into trend (piecewise-linear), seasonality (DFT amplitude peaks), and residual; normalize components separately then embed with soft prompts into a frozen-LLM-style (or cross-attention) encoder so forecasts are conditioned on interpretable structural parts rather than raw multimodal bars.
data_needed: Multimodal OHLC+indicator history (HistoryBars x BarDescr); piecewise-linear trend segments; discrete Fourier spectrum per channel; residual = raw - trend - seasonality.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test January 2024; 24-hour forecast horizon.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS an explicit structural regime sensor (trend vs seasonal vs residual/news-noise) before neural forecasting, with component-level normalization that preserves relative amplitudes across channels.
quote: the analyzed time series is broken down into its three fundamental components: trend, seasonality, and residuals. This decomposition occurs independently for each univariate time series

mechanism: After TEMPO (or any encoder) emits a forecast trajectory, apply CNeuronFreDFOCL to align predicted univariate series in the frequency domain (probability 0.7), so structure of upcoming movement is learned even when absolute scales are capped.
data_needed: Forecast tensor NForecast x BarDescr; FreDF frequency-matching layer.
why_new_for_mis: Adds a frequency-domain consistency sensor/regularizer on predicted paths—MIS can score forecast coherence independently of MSE scale.
quote: we introduced the CNeuronFreDFOCL frequency alignment block at the output of the Environmental State Encoder. This block is less sensitive to data scaling and enables the model to learn the structure of upcoming price movements

mechanism: Keep channel-independent Transformer highways (shared weights + learnable channel identifiers/positional PE) while a parallel PaT/CaT global-mixing branch produces mixed context; inject that context into each channel via cross-attention (Query=channel, Key/Value=global) so each series selectively absorbs useful inter-channel info without full channel mixing.
data_needed: Multimodal series X[L,M]; patches of size PatchSize; channel-id embeddings; independent-channel and mixed-channel Transformer encodings.
why_new_for_mis: MIS sensing of multivariate dependence without collapsing channels—noise-robust independent base plus selective global injection and channel specificity.
quote: they maintain the channel independence structure as the foundation, while selectively injecting global information (channel mixing) into each channel. This enables implicit channel mixing.

mechanism: Fit GaussianHMM (10 states, ensemble-averaged over n_models) on scaled features [returns, rolling-50 volatility, 50-period trend]; emit hidden-state sequence; map profitable states to bullish/bearish/exclude via cumulative returns-by-state bars and visual state overlays; use state as primary regime filter for trading (and Nash pairing on cointegrated negatives).
data_needed: Symbol close H4; pct returns; rolling std(window=50); pct_change(periods=50); StandardScaler; HMM transition/means/covariance matrices.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: USDJPY H4 primary (2020–2023 train); correlated/cointegrated pair USDJPY–EURCHF; multi EUR*/USD* scan.
why_new_for_mis: Concrete three-feature HMM regime sensor with ensemble-averaged matrices and empirical state profitability labeling—directly usable as MIS up/down/range classifier.
quote: This system utilizes both HMM and Log-Likelihood methods to classify the current market state into three categories: Uptrend, Downtrend, or Not Present (neutral).

mechanism: In live DetectMarketRegime, compute trendStrength=(fastEMA-slowEMA)/slowEMA and volatilityRatio=ATR/price plus normalized RSI; feed as HMM emission features and also gate Trend Strength strategy—volatility and trend strength are first-class sensing features, not just trade filters.
data_needed: EMA fast/slow, ATR, RSI, bid price on chart timeframe.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: USDJPY/EURCHF and related FX; H4 HMM; EA on PERIOD_CURRENT.
why_new_for_mis: Packages ATR/price volatility ratio with EMA trend strength into the same latent-state sensor stack MIS can reuse for regime and vol change.
quote:
double trendStrength = (fastEMA - slowEMA) / slowEMA;
    double volatilityRatio = atr / price;

mechanism: Replace quadratic Self-Attention with selective state-space (Mamba) blocks: input-dependent Δ,B,C let the recurrent hidden state filter irrelevant tokens and retain relevant long-range context with linear-time scan; stack three Mamba layers then channel-wise forecast heads.
data_needed: Normalized HistoryBars x BarDescr multimodal bars; hidden state per unit; SSM A/B/C projections.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test January 2024; 24h forecast.
why_new_for_mis: Offers MIS a linear-time long-context sequence sensor that can reset state to discard noise—complementary to Transformer encoders for regime/path sensing.
quote: They develop a simple selection mechanism that makes SSM parameters dependent on input data. This allows the model to filter out irrelevant information and retain relevant information indefinitely.

mechanism: After sparse contextual joint encoding (per-channel LSTM+MLP, Agent-Agent/Agent-Lane fusion attention), run high-level interaction Transformer then a Mamba block that scores alignment of motion states to 'lane' (trajectory-pattern) segments; top lanes form set M; Laplace multi-modal decoder emits trajectory modes.
data_needed: BarDescr x HistoryBars state matrix; per-bar and per-variable LSTM embeddings; Mamba lane-alignment vectors; forecast horizon NForecast.
why_new_for_mis: Introduces a probabilistic lane/path-alignment sensor: which structural trajectory templates currently match the agent—usable as multi-modal path regime for MIS.
quote: lane-aware probabilistic learning is introduced via a Mamba module... continuously assess the likelihood of aligning motion states with lane segments.

mechanism: On masked concatenated history+future (value, velocity, mask), Bidirectional Temporal Scaled (BTS) builds forward/backward distance-to-last-observation matrices; project with ReLU/exp decay and element-wise multiply Encoder features so influence of stale observations decays with gap length before bidirectional Mamba SSM and VAE decoder reconstruct/generate full trajectory.
data_needed: History and optional future tensors; binary masks; dropout masking in train; BTS S/S' scaling matrices.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; train 2023; test January 2024; 50% random mask during training.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit temporal-missingness sensor: scales features by how long a variable has been 'dark'—useful for irregular/gap-aware MIS sensing beyond complete bars.
quote: The proposed scaling matrix computes the distance from the last observation to the current time step, quantifying the impact of temporal gaps, especially when dealing with complex missing patterns.

mechanism: Build a multi-instrument Node network; run Fast Causal Inference (FCI) to discover PAGs with latent-confounder awareness; orient v-structures; feed selected causal links into an optimized multi-lag VAR that forecasts each node; sliding-window retrain keeps the causal+VAR sensor adaptive.
data_needed: Multi-symbol close histories; adjacency/PAG from FCI; VAR coefficients per node; lag selected by AIC.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD, GBPUSD, USDCAD, USDCHF, USDJPY, AUDUSD (optional XAUUSD, SP500m, ND100m); InputTimeframe convertible.
why_new_for_mis: MIS cross-asset causal graph sensor (not mere correlation) plus multivariate lead-lag forecasts for market-event anticipation.
quote: The bot uses a causal discovery algorithm, specifically the Fast Causal Inference (FCI) algorithm... The network structure and the relationships discovered through this analysis serve as inputs for the Vector Autoregression (VAR) model

mechanism: Replace absolute prices with relative per-step displacements; for each central agent rotate the local scene so the agent's motion is the reference axis; store float2 relative vectors of all agents vs center—translation- and rotation-invariant multimodal scene tensor for downstream hierarchical attention.
data_needed: Multimodal series per bar; HiVTPrepare kernel (theta=atan(delta), rotate neighbors).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Designed for multi-agent scenes; trading adaptation uses EURUSD H1 indicator channels as 'agents' (completed in final part).
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a geometry-normalized scene sensor for multivariate bars that is invariant to level and orientation—stable features across regimes.
quote: the authors avoid absolute positions and instead describe geometric attributes using relative positions. This makes the scene entirely a set of vectors.

mechanism: Local AAEncoder (gated Agent-Agent attention per timestep) + temporal MVMH attention + Agent-trajectory cross-attention (patch embeddings of short path segments) produce local embeddings; GlobalEncoder mixes full-scene tokens; decoder MLP emits F mixture Laplace trajectories per agent with SoftMax mixture weights—single forward pass multi-modal forecast.
data_needed: Vectorized TAD embeddings; line patches size 3; NumTraj=6 mixture components; NForecast horizon.
why_new_for_mis: Hierarchical local→global multi-agent trajectory sensor with explicit multi-modal mixture—MIS can read both consensus path and mode probabilities as regime uncertainty.
quote: The combined local and global representations enable the decoder to predict the future trajectories of all agents in a single forward pass of the model.

mechanism: MQL5 coding walkthrough of a rapid-fire EA using stock Parabolic SAR flip vs bar high/low plus SMA(60) trend filter on M1; classic indicator execution tutorial without a new sensing construct.
why_new_for_mis: After full read this is an EA implementation/optimization tutorial of well-known indicators—no novel regime/vol/liquidity/sequence sensor for MIS.
quote: A rapid-fire trading strategy focuses on profiting from quick and frequent market movements by executing multiple trades in a short timeframe

mechanism: Treat each history bar's BarDescr vector as a point; shared MLP/conv feature extractors + optional T-nets (orthogonal-regularized affine alignment) + symmetric MaxPooling yield a permutation-invariant global descriptor of the 'point cloud' of bars; SoftMax maps descriptor to latent regime/class probabilities for the Actor.
data_needed: HistoryBars points x BarDescr dims; T-net square transforms; max-pooled K-dim signature.
why_new_for_mis: Reframes market history as an unordered point set with MaxPool global signature—MIS gets order-invariant state typing robust to bar permutation and rigid transforms.
quote: the network learns a set of optimization functions that select significant or informative elements within the point cloud and encode the reasoning behind their selection.

mechanism: Compute N×N normalized pairwise distances in feature space (per-row max-normalize); LocalMaxPool within radius (0.2 then 0.4) aggregates neighborhood maxima so edge/sparse regions get larger effective receptive fields; stack two local PointNet layers then global PointNet for hierarchical local→global cloud features.
data_needed: Point feature matrix; distance matrix; radius hyperparameters; hierarchical local pools.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD H1; same setup as PointNet article; train 2023; test January 2024.
why_new_for_mis: Density-adaptive multi-scale neighborhood sensor for bar/feature clouds—MIS can capture fine structure in dense regimes and widen context when local evidence is sparse.
quote: increasing receptive fields at the cloud's periphery is a justified approach to ensure meaningful feature extraction.
